data.notes_barbara:
Different products; Different functional buyers; Different regulatory workflows

DFIN serves securities-reporting and capital-markets compliance needs. Its buyers and workflows differ from employer payroll and HR.
data.notes_matthew: Donnelley Financial does SEC filing and compliance software for public companies. The buyer is legal and finance, not human resources.

data.reason: Paylocity sells cloud payroll/HCM software to mid-sized employers (HR, payroll, tax filing for employees). DFIN sells regulatory filing, deal/document and fund compliance software and services to public issuers, funds, law firms and banks in capital markets. Products and buyers differ. Both use software subscriptions plus services, but that is a generic similarity only.
Both address corporate finance users, but DFIN focuses on securities reporting, regulatory communications and transaction diligence rather than payroll, workforce administration or spend management.

P1.1.text: Unify HR, Finance, & IT | HR & Payroll Simplified | Paylocity

P1.2.text: Paylocity unifies HR, Finance, and IT on one HCM platform, so you can stop piecing systems together and start moving forward together.

P1.3.text: The next evolution of work is here to automate manual processes, reduce risk, and help you move faster.

P1.5.text: Power every team with a single software

P1.6.text: Our flexible solutions drive innovation, enable smarter decisions, transform workforces, fuel growth, and inspire confident leadership.

P1.7.text: Simplify payroll and filing taxes with an intuitive, modern platform and expert support, knowing your payroll is accurate each time.

P1.8.text: Transform spend management – real-time visibility, AI-powered automation, seamless integration, smarter workflows.

P1.9.text: Centralize asset management, access control, and service support – empowering IT to enable the business, not just support it.

P1.10.text: A Payroll bundle is any new purchase of Payroll, standalone or bundled with other products.

P1.11.text: “It was everything we needed, all in one place. Paylocity’s solution helped modernize the entire employee experience.”

P1.12.text: “Paylocity helps us automate manual tasks, save time, and improve our decision-making with data and reporting.”

P1.13.text: What connects it all sets us apart

P1.14.text: Stay informed, engaged, and productive with one mobile experience.

P1.15.text: Automation and insight embedded in daily processes make everyone more efficient.

P1.16.text: Seamless connections across all your tools that unify data and user experience.

P1.17.text: Real-time dashboards and guided actions turn data into decisions.

P1.18.text: Automated processes from end to end save time and improve accuracy.

P1.19.text: Dedicated partnership and support you can count on.

P1.20.text: The ultimate platform for today's workforce

P1.21.text: Paylocity brings HR, Finance, and IT together to empower teams, simplify processes, and deliver real results. But we're more than a platform — we're the partner helping you shape the future of work.

P1.22.text: We stand by your side to help you hit your goals. Our ideas are grounded in your real needs — not in guesswork.

P1.23.text: Innovation is at the heart of what we do.

P1.24.text: Clients say we deliver the best service, and we strive to keep every interaction clear, helpful, and human.

P1.26.text: Dive into the latest research from industry leaders, and get the practical insights you need to automate smarter, act on real data, and make better workforce decisions.

P1.27.text: Bring HR and Finance together to streamline operations and control company-wide expenses in one place.

P1.28.text: The next evolution of work is here.

P1.29.text: Connect. Learn. Get more from Paylocity. Join us November 4-5

P1.30.text: Import your W-2 directly from Paylocity to one of three tax preparers at no cost and get a head start on your refund.

P2.2.text: From the just-starting-out local boutique to the rapidly growing franchises, from brokerage firms to associations, we tailor solutions for today and the future.

P2.3.text: Built for teams who value connection and efficiency

P2.4.text: Executives and business owners steer the ship. You need a solution that keeps productivity up and turnover down.

P2.5.text: HR leaders are the champions of a thriving workforce, creating a culture for everyone. You need a platform that matches your passion for nurturing talent.

P2.6.text: Employees expect the right pay, every time, and payroll admins are there to get it right every time. You need tools to simplify the process and lighten your load.

P2.7.text: IT is the guardian of a company's infrastructure. You depend on systems that keep technology functioning smoothly, protect data, and scale for growth.

P2.8.text: Employees are at the heart of any business. You need simple, but impactful solution to stay connected to your coworkers and culture.

P2.9.text: For brokers, advisors, consultants, and advocates by any other name, relationships are everything. The right platform helps you deepen client relationships and grow your book

P1.1.text: DFIN | Financial Risk, Compliance and Software Solutions

P1.2.text: We provide advanced financial solutions software, compliance tools, and global reporting support—empowering your business at every stage.

P1.3.text: Powerful Software. Dedicated Experts. All in one Solution.

P1.4.text: Solutions built for the way you work

P1.5.text: That's why DFIN gives you both — the software and dedicated expertise.

P1.6.text: Securely manage due diligence, transactions, and corporate information with DFIN Venue®. The Venue VDR is intentionally designed for the speed, confidence, and precision modern transactions demand. DFIN Active Intelligence™ extends these capabilities with AI Document Summaries and AI Document Translation, helping teams understand documents faster, accelerate multilingual review, and support secure, governed diligence workflows.

P1.7.text: Paired with DFIN Active Intelligence™ extends those capabilities with AI-powered analysis capabilities helping reporting teams accelerate content review, improve consistency, surface critical information, and generate first-pass drafts within established reporting workflows.

P1.8.text: Harness the power of our global financial solutions to navigate complex regulations across multiple jurisdictions. Arc Suite supports end-to-end operations for fund and insurance companies to keep you ahead of evolving global regulatory and compliance requirements, now powered by DFIN's AI tool, Active Intelligence™.

P1.9.text: Powering every stage of your corporate lifecycle

P1.10.text: DFIN is the finance solutions company you can trust at every phase—startup, growth, or transformation—ensuring compliance and efficiency.

P1.12.text: Meet financial, regulatory, and ESG requirements accurately and securely with Excel-based, single-source data management, easy team collaboration and improved workflows.

P1.13.text: Venue secure VDR and data room services help streamline M&A diligence, improve negotiations and reduce cost for strategic transactions with data privacy protection, auto-redaction capabilities and self-launching data rooms.

P1.15.text: Optimize efficiencies — experience seamless, turn-key, expert-supported proxy statement solutions from advisory services, strategy, design and print to annual meeting services and more.

P1.16.text: Four purpose-built products. One powerful end-to-end solution.

P1.17.text: DFIN’s Arc Suite offers regulatory, reporting, legal, filing and distribution solutions through one integrated financial compliance management software platform.

P1.18.text: ArcPro® offers intuitive, cloud-based workflow tools and managerial dashboards to streamline the review and approval process for prospectus building and a wide range of other regulatory communications.

P1.19.text: DFIN’s financial compliance solutions ingest data, perform calculations and produce compliant reports for requirements in Europe including PRIIPs, MiFID II and PRIIPs KID.

P1.20.text: Compliance Management Built for Investment Companies

P1.21.text: ArcDigital supports all the key functions required for digital content delivery including a centralized document repository, compliance material tracking and digital asset management all in a one-stop ecosystem.

P1.22.text: Five purpose-built products. One powerful end-to-end solution.

P1.23.text: DFIN’s regulatory reporting software solution ingests data, performs calculations and produces compliant reports for requirements in Europe including PRIIPs, MiFID II and PRIIPs KID.

P1.26.text: Maintain readiness and work through deals faster to spur growth
